scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tqa/shared build && pnpm --filter @tqa/evidence-collector build && pnpm --filter @tqa/qa-agent build && pnpm --filter @tqa/validators build && pnpm --filter @tqa/quality-gate build && pnpm --filter @tqa/api build && pnpm --filter @tqa/storefront build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tqa/shared build && pnpm --filter @tqa/evidence-collector build && pnpm --filter @tqa/qa-agent build && pnpm --filter @tqa/validators build && pnpm --filter @tqa/quality-gate build && pnpm --filter @tqa/api build && pnpm --filter @tqa/storefront typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/contract/*.test.ts tests/e2e/*.test.ts tests/evals/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=regression
scripts.test:e2e:ghost-oracle: pnpm run build && playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=expected-negative
